name: google-project-sync-ownership
goal: Keep moved portable client helpers with their owner and retain Harness migration identities

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: Root check found the portable bridge move left four owner-local migration entries pointing at forwarding files. New refresh dependencies also need explicit registry expectations.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the bug; name the scenario, fixture, lifecycle or assertion gap and reusable test change.
steps.evidence: The existing root migration and workspace-registry standardized tests caught the gap. Keep their strict owner-folder, definition hash and stable identity assertions; update only the expected new shared dependencies.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: Test-only 7a1624a6 records failing checkpoint 789cb3a8: commentEntries definition changed and three other owner-local records still point at forwarding files. The strict unchanged root guard rejects the move.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: Private comment and artifact helpers now live beside browserBridge, with all public forwards preserved. Four migration records name the new owner-local paths and retain original definition hashes and identities. Root 15, bridge 21 and focused Desktop 16 checks pass.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending until proof passes.
